text: A conservator examines blue ceramic fragments recovered from an abandoned hillside kiln. Some pieces carry matching glaze marks, while others were fired at different temperatures. Describe a practical investigation using observations that could be recorded and checked independently. Explain which comparisons would be informative, identify at least one remaining uncertainty, and distinguish a plausible explanation from a conclusion established by the evidence.
